#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string input;
    std::getline(std::cin, input);
    int finalCount = 0;
    
    if (!input.empty()) {
        int i = 0;
        int length = input.length();
        while (i < length) {
            char current = input[i];
            int j = i;
            while (j < length && input[j] == current) {
                j++;
            }
            int seqLength = j - i;
            if (seqLength % 2 == 0) {
                finalCount++;
            }
            i = j;
        }
    }
    
    std::cout << finalCount << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
